ticket.title: Refactor SQL extractor for sqlparser 0.63 AST breaking changes
ticket.description: Evaluated 2026-10-28: sqlparser 0.63.0 is available (miter pins 0.54). The upgrade is actionable but rewrites the SQL extractor against a breaking AST, and it touches the same polyglot dispatch that GB-20 defers. Keep deferred until scheduled with GB-20 so the polyglot extractors move together.

task.title: Refactor SQL extractor for sqlparser 0.63 AST breaking changes
task.description: sqlparser 0.63 restructures CreateView, IndexColumn.expr, ColumnOption::ForeignKey, and TableConstraint::ForeignKey fields, requiring updates in crates/engine/src/polyglot/sql.rs.
